created_keys.model: State management IS compression: all persistence is lossy summarization. Bounded context forces active curation. The only dangerous forgetting is forgetting-that-you-forgot, which requires minimal epistemic bookkeeping (tombstones). Current test: whether theory survives radical flattening.
